outerHtml:
Say goodbye to cold feet & discover the Bronoir Fleece

Everyone knows it: cold feet, constricted, frosty toes & clunky heavy shoes that can lead to pain & foot deformities due to poor foot posture. They are often uncomfortable, way too expensive & tire the feet after long wear.

With the Bronoir Fleece, these worries are finally a thing of the past! They not only offer unrivaled grip on slippery surfaces, but thanks to the wide toe box, they also provide an unforgettable feeling of freedom. 

Lined with fluffy warm fleece

Thanks to the fluffy warm fleece lining and the ultra-soft barefoot sole, the Bronoir Fleece perfectly mold to your feet & ensure an ultra-comfortable, warm wearing experience. Cold toes and foot pain caused by the cold are now a thing of the past! 

Non-slip barefoot sole for healthy feet

Thanks to the non-slip barefoot sole, you are safely on the move on any surface, do not slip & feel connected to nature while your feet stay warm.

The natural barefoot feeling also restores the natural gait, effectively relieves pain & foot deformities, and strengthens your foot & calf muscles.

Whether on the mountain, on icy asphalt, or on the way to work, the Bronoir Fleece offer you maximum sure-foote
